app-templates.message:
docs(interactive): the architecture rebuilt with the arc42 guide, before review

## Intent

The architecture should follow the method of the arc42 CLI and its guide, and name every generic component, also the optional ones an app may never use. Open points go to review before validation.

## Key changes

- All twelve chapters rebuilt from the guide's chapter briefs, with an evidence file that lists the sources and marks open questions.
- Building blocks for runtime, tooling helpers and the app, with interfaces. Optional or not yet built components are included and marked: tutor handoff, tutor model in the browser, task numbers, exercise contract, settings, large storage.
- Constraints, runtime scenarios, deployment, concepts, decisions, risks and a glossary.
- Not validated yet: the guide asks for review first.

## Dependencies and side effects

- Revised after review in the next commit of app-templates#34 (i110).
